text_en: Rome, the eternal city... I can't wait to explore your seven hills!
Life is a cabaret, old chum. Come to the cabaret!
Ella... you're so "bella"! Oh, I'm such a Roman poet, aren't I?
It's good to be back cruising on the "Love Boat"!
I've found my fair lady. Ella... you put the spark back in my heart!
If work isn't fun, you're not playing on the right team!
Can't wait to have real Italian ice cream in front of the Pantheon in Rome!
When in Rome, do as the Romans do! Duly noted, so I will...
Rough waters make tough sailors! Let your dreams set sail...
At sea, I learned how little a person needs, not how much... and all we need is love.
